notes: §1985:VI.6.11.2 prints five DIVIDE formats, each ending [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ] [ END-DIVIDE ], in that sequence (§1985:IV.2.1). divideStatement parses the union, ArithmeticBinder.BindDivide narrows it to the five formats at every edition (COBOL1689 through GivingSendingOperand and Format1Receivers), VisitRoundedPhrase refuses ROUNDED MODE below 2014 (COBOL0803), and VisitConditionalPhrases through ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder now refuses NOT ON SIZE ERROR before ON SIZE ERROR at 85 (COBOL0900, the landed fix of kb/Work PB5158), the one arm the prior read found missing. Probed at --std 85: all five formats run with ON omitted and END-DIVIDE (F1 4 and 0, F2 1 and 1.0, F3 3 and 3.1, F4 3 rem 1, F5 3.1 rem 0); (b) refused: the reversed phrases, ON SIZE ERROR twice, no dividend, a literal receiver in format 1, two INTO operands, BY without GIVING, REMAINDER without GIVING, two GIVING receivers with REMAINDER, ROUNDED after REMAINDER; (c) ROUNDED MODE IS refused; (d) a group and an edited format-1 receiver refused, ALL "1" refused, ZERO as divisor takes SIZE ERROR, an edited GIVING receiver holds -  3.14; (f) zero divisor leaves the receiver, 18 nines divide exactly, a too-small receiver keeps its value under SIZE ERROR, DIVIDE 2 INTO I TE (I) uses the updated I (TE (1) = 25) and DIVIDE 2 INTO TE (I) GIVING I TE (I) gives I 2, TE (2) 12. The witness runs all five formats in the printed phrase order. || REFUTED: PARTIAL: at --std 85 an integer or numeric function-identifier is accepted as a DIVIDE operand (and as an ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY operand), contrary to §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4; harm under-rejects. Expected: refused, as WRITE FROM FUNCTION LENGTH is (COBOL1914). kb/Work PB5108 holds the defect (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06-refute.json; rerun op-20261114/records-rs5a/rerun-log.txt).
